from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
p=Path('.trellis/tasks/10-03-geo-408-api-acceptance/evidence')
b=json.loads((p/'baseline-sha256.json').read_text())
patch=(p/'candidate.patch').read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
for path in ['Makefile','.trellis/spec/infra/e2e-isolation.md']:
    start=patch.index('--- a/'+path+'\n')
    end=next((i for i in range(start+2,len(patch)) if patch[i].startswith('--- a/')),len(patch))
    hunks=[]; i=start+2
    while i<end:
        m=re.match(r'@@ -\d+(?:,\d+)? \+(\d+)(?:,\d+)? @@',patch[i])
        if not m: i+=1; continue
        new_start=int(m[1])-1; i+=1; old=[]; new=[]
        while i<end and not patch[i].startswith('@@ '):
            line=patch[i]
            if line.startswith((' ','-')): old.append(line[1:])
            if line.startswith((' ','+')): new.append(line[1:])
            i+=1
        hunks.append((new_start,old,new))
    current=Path(path).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True); output=[]; at=0
    for new_start,old,new in hunks:
        assert current[new_start:new_start+len(new)]==new,(path,new_start,'candidate differs')
        output.extend(current[at:new_start]); output.extend(old); at=new_start+len(new)
    output.extend(current[at:])
    h=hashlib.sha256(''.join(output).encode()).hexdigest()
    print(json.dumps({'path':path,'in_memory_recovered_baseline_hash_match':h==b[path],'hunk_count':len(hunks)}))
PY
 tail -n 24 .trellis/tasks/10-03-geo-408-api-acceptance/evidence/make-e2e.log",max_output_tokens:1600})).output);
